name: Far Cry 3: Ultimate Edition
storyline: Far beyond the limits of civilization lies an island, a lawless place ruled by violence and human suffering, where the only escape is through drugs or the muzzle of a gun. It is here that the protagonist finds himself stranded, trapped in a place that has forgotten right from wrong. To survive in a world governed by brutality, he is forced to live by the same principles of violence that rule the island.
summary: This Ultimate Edition includes all bonus DLC content: Monkey Business Pack, Lost Expeditions, Warrior Pack, and Predator Pack.
